title: Development of a Mindfulness-Based Smartphone Application for BMT Caregivers
official: Development of a Mindfulness-Based Smartphone Application for BMT Caregivers
summary: This pilot study evaluates the feasibility, acceptability, usability, and engagement of a smartphone-delivered mindfulness intervention for caregivers of hematopoietic stem cell transplant (HCT) patients. Thirty caregivers will use the app for six weeks beginning the week prior to the patient's transplant. Participants will complete baseline and end-of-treatment surveys and a brief qualitative interview.
conditions: Caregivers of Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplant (HCT) Patients
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥18
* Identified caregiver of a patient scheduled for HCT at Moffitt Cancer Center
* Able to provide informed consent
* Able to read and write in English
* Owns a smartphone and willing to download the study app

Exclusion Criteria:

* None beyond failure to meet inclusion criteria
sponsor: H. Lee Moffitt Cancer Center and Research Institute
